maddeler.e:
تهالكت (form VI)
# تَهَالَكْتُ (tahālaktu) /ta.haː.lak.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# تَهَالَكْتَ (tahālakta) /ta.haː.lak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# تَهَالَكْتِ (tahālakti) /ta.haː.lak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# تَهَالَكَتْ (tahālakat) /ta.haː.la.kat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
